summary: Shared RSA private SSH key embedded in cli.js grants login to author-operated build server
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in CONFIG.encodedSSHKey, decodes it to a temp file, and invokes execSync('ssh... -i <key> ubuntu@79.72.65.161...') for remote build and deploy operations. The same private key ships in every published tarball, so anyone who downloads the package can authenticate as the shared ubuntu account on 79.72.65.161 (/home/ubuntu/signing-server). Because all installers share one account on the author's signing server, any installer (or any third party who extracts the key) can read or tamper with other installers' uploaded project sources and signed build outputs stored under that account. The package does not exfiltrate installer secrets, execute attacker-controlled code at install/import time, or open a backdoor into the installer's host; the exposed credential authorizes access to the author's server and to build artifacts other users upload there.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
